corrected_provenance_audit.diagnosis: The Wave-5 report built one global proposition_id map across all nine papers. proposition_id encodes page/region offsets but not paper identity, so identical IDs from later papers overwrote earlier entries and caused false cross-paper comparisons. Recomputing the same check within each owning paper proves all 70 accepted claims exactly match the authoritative proposition source text and page.
corrected_provenance_audit.action: Fix the hard-safety lookup to scope proposition identity by paper before the next benchmark. Do not interpret the raw false flag as a real provenance regression.

selector_specification_diagnosis.root_cause: Wave 5 called the existing BM25 scorer separately for each region, which recomputed document frequency/IDF on only that region's propositions. The motivating offline diagnostic scored all exact propositions from the paper's selected regions in one BM25 corpus, then retained the highest-scoring proposition within each region.
selector_specification_diagnosis.exact_reproduction: Recomputing paper-global proposition BM25 on the preserved Wave-4 artifact and then taking the top proposition per region reproduces mean teacher-source F1 0.30305743036333815.
selector_specification_diagnosis.conclusion: The pre-Wave-5 deterministic-selector diagnostic was not faithfully tested. A corrected one-variable experiment is justified.

normalization_residual.note: Keep the normalization prompt/schema/guard fixed for the corrected selector experiment so selector quality remains isolated.
